recordings.note: The 5 words and 13 required lines play (kingdom voice, generated, checked by transcription). The 16 letter sounds play from the Open Letter Sounds library (CC0, a synthetic voice), approved on the owner's instruction: nobody has listened to any of them yet, and a letter sound that adds a vowel ('puh') teaches the wrong sound, so a person still needs to hear each one (node scripts/letter-sounds.js page). The six help framing lines and four reactions are not recorded. The checklist is wordGarden.recordings.json.
